title: POST /sync/push-final – request
description: The last upload of a revoked device, in as many requests as it takes: batches of its unacknowledged chain entries in ascending seq order, checked like POST /sync/push, then its photos (PUT /media/{id}), then a request with done true. After that request the upload is closed, even if entries were rejected or photos are missing: push-final and PUT /media/{id} answer 401 device_revoked. A device that is not revoked gets 403 forbidden. Token of the revoked device; requires an Idempotency-Key header. device_id must equal the token's device and the device_id of every entry. Response: 200, api/sync-push-final.response.json.

entries.description: May be empty: nothing is left to send in the request that closes the upload.

done.description: true: this is the last request, close the upload after it.
